card.name: Words just before a clause's main point
card.fires_on: Small connecting or auxiliary words (so, then, will, likely, reply, long) in the middle of a clause, right where the main verb or point is about to come.

modes.label: Linking words
modes.description: Conjunctions or filler like so, then, or a comma that open the main clause after a condition.
modes.example: you're probably born after the 80s<< so>> don't worry about it.

modes.label: Auxiliary or modal words
modes.description: Words like will, may long, would also, or likely that come before the main verb.
modes.example: means that there<< will>> always be scope for the state to expand
